KeysToEntries.AgonyAuntchovyDesc: Sad little fish love a shoulder to cry on. Increases the chance of catching an upset fish in Umbral Sands.
KeysToEntries.ArmouredCatfishDesc: No sense crying over spilled milk.
KeysToEntries.SardineDesc: A small fish with big emotions.
KeysToEntries.QuestStartDialogue1: Sob… sniff. Oh, human, don’t you start! Three trips now and each catch has come up whimpering. This morning, my whole basket of fish was crying.
KeysToEntries.QuestStartDialogue2: Not to mention the taste! There's nothing the Manafem despise more than a miserable fish. I’ve no idea what’s upsetting them. Go and see for yourself.
KeysToEntries.QuestStartDialogue3: Take this special bait: they seem drawn to it. Catch a Snivelling Sardine with it and cleanse it in the bath beside me. Perhaps we can cheer up supper!
KeysToEntries.QuestDesc: Taliesin the Manafem Fisher needs help cheering up some sad fish.
KeysToEntries.BathTubAddFishPrompt: Give the miserable fish a bath?
KeysToEntries.QuestGiverBathCompleteDialogue4: If you find any more sulking freshwater critters, bring them to the bath. Ill pay you chits for any cheered-up chum that you bring me!
KeysToEntries.Objective2Description: Gather Ground Gypsum, Cactus Water, Shimmerscale Powder and bring it back to Taliesin.
KeysToEntries.ReturnWithFish_NotComplete: Put three more crying fish into the soothing bath! The water’s getting cold, and I refuse to draw a second bath for something that lives in water.
KeysToEntries.ReturnWithFirstFish_NotComplete: Use the bait I gave you at this fishing spot, human. Cleanse one crying fish in the bath beside me, then we’ll talk.
KeysToEntries.BathTubBeforeFish: A bath that the Manafem seem to use for preparing fish.
KeysToEntries.Objective_CatchFirstFish_Hint: Use Agony Auntchovy Bait at the fishing spot near Taliesin.
KeysToEntries.BathTubWithQuestItems: Add the items to the bath?
KeysToEntries.BathTubQuestItemsAdded: Happy fish, not a dry eye in the tub!
KeysToEntries.BathTubOnItemsAdded: The bath looks much more relaxing now.
KeysToEntries.QuestGiverQuestAfterCompleteDialogue: If you find any more sulking freshwater critters, bring them to the bath. Ill pay you chits for any cheered-up chum that you bring me!
KeysToEntries.QuestGiverBathCompleteDialogue1: Can you hear that? Oh, what wonderful silence! Serene, calming. Not even a whimper. Just four fish in a tub without a care in the world.
KeysToEntries.QuestGiverBathCompleteDialogue2: They say the ancient goddess Elidinis wept in her grief over these desert sands. Her tears brought water to this barren place. Perhaps a little of her sorrow rubbed off on these scamps.
KeysToEntries.QuestGiverBathCompleteDialogue3: Well, you’ve saved my catch and spared the clan another miserable supper! Here is your reward and a rack for your fishing rods. I would offer you these fish as well, but I’ve already named them all. We're friends now.
KeysToEntries.DeliverBathItems_Choice: Hand over the items for the soothing bath?
KeysToEntries.QuestCompletedJournalEntry:
You helped figure out how to cheer up the sad fish in the desert.

Taliesin will reward you for any more sad fish you bring to the bath.
KeysToEntries.ReturnWithBathItems_NotComplete: Bring those bath ingredients straight to me, human. I’ve tried telling the fish to pull itself together, but it made us both worse.
KeysToEntries.BathReady_OnFishAdded: Happy fish! Not a dry eye in the tub!
KeysToEntries.ReturnWithBathItems_Complete_1: Just like the baths my Mum made! Let me prepare the soothing bath… now look! Not even a sniffle. Swimming about without a care in the world.
KeysToEntries.ReturnWithBathItems_Complete_2: Well, one happy fish won’t feed a clan. We should try this again. Misery loves company! Take the bait to three other fishing spots and catch more sad specimens.
KeysToEntries.ReturnWithBathItems_Complete_3: Bring them straight to the bath and see how they fare. If those minerals could settle me after a scolding from Mum, three more fish should be no trouble!
KeysToEntries.FirstFishDelivered: You put the sad fish in the bath. It still looks sad.
KeysToEntries.Objective_CatchRemainingFish_Description: Bring a Depressed Desert Sole, Inconsolable Catfish and a Bawling Beltfish to the soothing bath.
KeysToEntries.Objective_CatchFirstFish_Description: Put a Snivelling Sardine in the Bath.
KeysToEntries.Objective_CatchRemainingFish_Hint: Each oasis contains a different sad fish. Catch one in each, using the Agony Auntchovy bait.
KeysToEntries.BathWithOneHappyFish: The fish seems in better spirits.
KeysToEntries.ReturnWithFirstFish_Complete_1: What's got you so upset, fishy? No responsibilities, no complaints, no mother telling you what a disappointment you’ve become.
KeysToEntries.ReturnWithFirstFish_Complete_2: My dear Mum did have her moments. She’d draw me a warm bath with soothing minerals if I was upset. Calmed me right down! Perhaps that’s what this poor little fish needs.
KeysToEntries.ReturnWithFirstFish_Complete_3: Bring me Ground Gypsum, Cactus Water and Shimmerscale Powder for a soothing bath, whilst I give our fishy friend a shoulder to cry on.
KeysToEntries.RewardPackFlavourText: A reward for helping cheer up some sad fish.
KeysToEntries.BeltfishPristineDesc: A Pristine Beltfish, that appears to be sobbing.
KeysToEntries.DesertSolePristineDesc: A Pristine Desert Sole, that could use someone to talk to.
KeysToEntries.QuestGiverQuestNotAvailable: Sob... sniff. Not right now, human. Help my clan first. Sob...sniff, maybe then you can help me.
KeysToEntries.Journal.AgonyAuntchovy: To attract fish with a sad disposition, there's little better than an understanding anchovy. Misery loves company!
KeysToEntries.Journal.DepressedDesertSole: For a flatfish without much weight to it, the desert sole can’t half wail! It’s especially melancholic around this time of year. Best to stand back and let it cry itself out. You’d think something that spends its life at the bottom would be used to feeling low.
KeysToEntries.Journal.BawlingBeltfish: Raw Beltfish are a tricky customer. Its tough, but even the toughest fish need a good cry sometimes. Don't let their dark eyes fool you. One harsh word and it'll be blubbering with the best of them.
KeysToEntries.Journal.SnivellingSardine: Sardines travel in large shoals but even in the biggest communities, a poor fish can still feel lonely. Everyone feels better after a little cry.
KeysToEntries.Journal.InconsolableCatfish: You’re going to struggle to prepare this properly if it can’t stop crying! Make sure you have a very sharp knife and several packs of tissues. Try not to get attached, it’s already having trouble letting go.
